design_system.name: Organic Productivity
design_system.description: A calm, tactile, and focused interface that mimics the warmth of paper and physical organization tools. Avoids cold digital grays.

usage_rules.text_contrast: Always use #4A3728 for main text on #F5EBE0 backgrounds. Never use pure black.
usage_rules.borders: Use #E8D5C4 for structural dividers. Use #e11d48 (Rose) only for high-priority actions or blocked states.
usage_rules.shadows: Use colored shadows (e.g., shadow-amber-900/5) instead of gray shadows to maintain warmth.

specs.title_section: col-span-full md:col-span-8 bg-white/50 p-8 rounded-2xl border border-[#E8D5C4]
specs.stats_section: col-span-full md:col-span-4 bg-[#E8D5C4]/30 p-8 rounded-2xl flex flex-col justify-center

specs.column: min-w-[320px] w-[320px] bg-[#E8D5C4]/20 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-3 snap-center border border-transparent hover:border-[#E8D5C4]/50 transition-colors
specs.column_title: font-bold text-[#4A3728] text-lg flex items-center gap-2
specs.count_badge: bg-[#4A3728]/10 text-[#4A3728] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold

specs.card: bg-white p-4 rounded-lg border border-[#E8D5C4]/50 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all group relative touch-none select-none
specs.dragging_state: z-50 shadow-2xl scale-105 rotate-2 opacity-90 cursor-grabbing ring-2 ring-[#4A3728]/20
specs.title: font-medium text-[#4A3728] leading-snug group-hover:text-rose-600 transition-colors
specs.footer: flex items-center justify-between mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-[#F5EBE0]

drag_and_drop.requirements: Use closestCorners collision detection. Implement DragOverlay for smooth visuals. Ensure accessibility with keyboard sensors.

interaction.blocked_tasks: Cannot be moved to 'Completed'. Shake animation if tried.
interaction.click_action: Clicking card opens Task Detail modal (placeholder).
interaction.add_task: Button at bottom of column or top header.

testing.attributes: data-testid required on all interactive elements (e.g., 'task-card-123', 'column-todo', 'add-task-btn')
testing.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios for text on cream backgrounds. Drag handles must be keyboard accessible.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Refactor 'ProjectDetails.js' to use the Bento Grid header layout.
2. Implement 'KanbanBoard.js' using DndKit. Create columns dynamically.
4. Ensure the DndKit 'DragOverlay' is used so the dragged item appears above everything else with a slight rotation.
6. Do NOT use default gray/blue colors. Every surface must be warm.
7. Mock data for tasks if backend is not ready, but structure it for real API integration.

universal_guidelines.general: Avoid 'AI Slop' aesthetics. No generic gradients. Use texture and warmth.
universal_guidelines.files: Use .js extension for components as per project structure (not .tsx).
universal_guidelines.imports: Import Shadcn UI components from '@/components/ui/...'. Import icons from 'lucide-react'.
